title: True Royale
subtitle: Real stories from the Island, and how to pull them off yourself
version_note: Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.30. Stories up to 14 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book of true stories from the Override season: clever plays, cracked codes, championship heartbreak and a race to the South Pole, each with a breakdown of the game mechanic behind it.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Pick three you didn't know before, and use each one today. Extra Chug Jugs if you use one in the lobby.
